records.rationale: Encounter is inside Shatter Mage's tower; tower is mistyped as item. located_in would admit once the place is a location — do not widen located_in object to arbitrary items for this case.
Refugees 'from Edge' encodes origin/provenance, not mereological part_of a location.
part_of_group bundles group membership with an unresolved refugee mystery/situation; cannot flatten to one relationship term.
Clearing rats from basements is activity at a place, not participates_in a location (object must be encounter/event).
Source describes a monster attacking the cube/Ogonob while Karsemine fights on the wall; does not support cube located_in Karsemine.
Council headquarters and 'the Council' place are the same site.
Runes are a detection tool for corrupted meat — investigative/causal use, not dnd5e:leads_to path connectivity between locations.
Paper bird flies around Grobnok; present_at object should be a place/event, not a person. Widening would weaken present_at.
Source: Wolf downs an Invisibility Potion and disappears — consumption/use, not carriage. Reversing to dnd5e:carries would invent a different fact; requires authored correction.
Creature climbs toward the ceiling; motion/approach, not location path leads_to.
Source: seed lands in Stafl's hand and tentacles wrap around it — same hand-held possession fact as dnd5e:holds (PC→item), not carries/transport and not item located_in PC.
Source/label: torch tossed/passed to Baergrom — transfer/handoff event, not durable carries. Reversing to carries invents carriage instead of preserving the asserted pass.
Source/label: torch tossed/passed to Karsemine — transfer/handoff event, not durable carries. Reversing to carries invents carriage instead of preserving the asserted pass.
Boulder resolves into the statue foot — same object identity.
Help request posted on the job board is spatial location-on-container; existing located_in semantics stay intact if item objects (surfaces/containers) are admitted.
Job posting solicits mercenaries — audience/mission targeting plus request semantics; not one atomic relationship.
Hidden alchemy room item/location duplicate of one place.
Label 'site of' inverts containment and types the project as party; authored structure is wrong for located_in.
Last warehouse reached is the chilled warehouse — same place.
Packing area belongs to a logistics site/network mistyped as party; correct kinds before any part_of endpoint work.
River beside/under Stone Bridge is a location mistyped as mystery; do not widen contains to mysteries.
Academy tied to potion-making use of mushrooms mixes institution, objective, and mystery topic.
Discovered entrance location duplicates the mystery node.
College within Mirathorn is location→location located_in once the city is typed as location (currently party).
Mushrooms 'to be taken to academy' mixes transport intent, destination, and mystery topic — not path leads_to.
Ogonob/mystery contained in the dark cube; located_in with item as container object preserves spatial semantics.
Barin proposes operations at guardhouses; plan involvement, not a path edge from NPC to location.
carries_report_to encodes courier + report + destination/analysis request in one predicate.
Cultist ritually feeds/heals the meat creature; serves semantics hold if object kinds admit the served entity (item/threat/creature).

Source: Lesandra is at the front of the cultist crowd and orders them silent — same leadership fact as durable led_by label. Rename/reverse part_of→dnd5e:leads (Lesandra→cultists) preserves that fact.
Fey bargain offering Torbin mixes deal terms, objective, and custody — not one relationship.
Fey appears to Ephanna in prison — directed appearance/visitation, not present_at a person as place.
Warehouse club 'for' goblinoids is venue association; party contains faction is the wrong structural encoding.
Head of the Wizard's College is organizational leadership; college is mistyped as location. Extending leads to locations would confuse path/escort senses.
Townsfolk gather for revelry; revelry is mistyped as group rather than event/encounter required by participates_in.
Source: party accepts a ride to Stone Bridge with Pippa and she led the crew toward that destination — same agent→location travel fact as dnd5e:travels_to. Do not widen path leads_to to agents.
Pippa hitches Bubbles to the wagon — accompaniment/harness, not travels_to a creature destination.
Recap: dead horse served for Bonogo by Ephanna; durable edge subject/object and label disagree with source food-service claim.
Runaway cart stopped by Baergrom is patient/agent inversion under participates_in; requires source correction.
Torbin begins showing oily-eye symptoms — condition attribution linked to a mystery node, not identity and not a single relationship.
Representative of the Guilds; guilds mistyped as location. serves to a faction would already be endpoint-admitted.
reports_threat_in bundles reporting speech act + threat topic + place context.
Crew belongs to Torvak's caravan group mistyped as item; member_of already admits group/faction/party objects.
Wolf's head materializes as part of the meat creature; mereological part_of stays coherent if creature/npc subjects are admitted with item composites.
Bill shows oily-eye symptoms / link to oily-eyed guards mystery — condition attribution, not identity.
may-close-gate mixes authority/control over a location with a communications-shaped predicate name.
Coordinates assault with Caelynn is tactical coordination of a person, not organizational leads (object should be group/faction/party).
Structural threatens Lysandra→cultists contradicts durable qualifier is-threatened-by-cultists; requires authored correction, not auto-reverse.
Meat pile crawls toward rack — locomotion toward an object, not routes_to/leads_to path semantics.
Oil poured/applied onto the meat rack; application, not carries.
Evidence discusses oily eyes on Wolf/guards, not that oil is identified as Wolf.
Scroll item and mystery describing the same discovered scroll are identity duplicates, not a factual relationship.
Bonogo bars the door to protect prisoners — atomic protection of a group; Buddy predicate name is compound but source claim is protects.
Bonogo climbs to reach/heal Karsemine — approach to a person, not travels_to a location; widening destinations to PCs would weaken the term.
Caelynn calls Grobnok — atomic communication. Do not inherit the compound controls_comms_with name as the published term.
Caelynn joins festivities; revelry mistyped as group instead of event.
Ephanna uses mage hand to lasso Bubbles — tool use, not communications.

Source: Ephanna goes along with Lyra's followers, wants to help, then discovers they are called The Shepherds Flock — accompaniment/affiliation discovery, not membership and not participates_in an event. Mapping to dnd5e:member_of would invent a different fact.

Source/label: epic performance spreading the song of the party — performance-for-audience, not membership. Independent party membership cannot replace this assertion's meaning; do not adapt to member_of.
